summary: Stocks clawed back some ground Wednesday after last week's NVIDIA leadership shock, but the bounce stayed shallow as VIX held near 25 and a surging dollar near 104 kept real yields elevated, pinning gold to its own fear reading. Bitcoin kept sliding deeper into oversold territory, extending the broad de-risking gripping every asset class this month.
tweet: Stocks bounced Wednesday but stayed fragile post-NVIDIA shock, as a surging dollar pinned gold and bitcoin sank deeper into oversold territory.
